This was a '''datapad''' that belonged to the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Calo Nord]], who lived during the time of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and the [[Jedi Civil War]]. The datapad contained a record of Nord's kills. In [[3956 BBY]], the final year of the Jedi Civil War, the reigning [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Malak|Malak]] ordered the planet of Taris [[Destruction of Taris|destroyed]] in an attempt to kill the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Bastila Shan]]. Shan had crashed on Taris aboard an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] when the Sith fleet [[Attack on the Endar Spire|ambushed and boarded]] her warship, the ''[[Endar Spire]]''.

After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Carth Onasi]] and the amnesiac former [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] found and rescued Bastila Shan, the Mandalorian Canderous Ordo approached them with an offer to steal the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'', the flagship of Ordo's employer, [[Exchange]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Davik Kang]], but only if they broke in the [[Tarisian military base|Tarisian Sith base]] and acquired the Sith's launch codes. Shan, Onasi, and Revan obliged, and, with the assistance of Kang's droid [[T3-M4]], managed to steal the codes. Ordo then took the group to [[Davik Kang's estate|Kang's estate]].

After they arrived, Revan, Ordo, Shan, and Onasi attempted to disable the hangar's security. There was a trophy room which displayed the mounted heads of animals such as [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]]. When Revan searched one of the [[Footlocker/Legends|footlockers]] in the room, he found Calo Nord's datapad. After they were given codes for the ''Ebon Hawk'' by the ship's former pilot [[Hudrow]], who was imprisoned and [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] after angering Kang, the group proceeded to unlock the hangar bay's security. Kang and Nord encountered them, and attempted to kill them. However, when the Sith began to bombard the planet, some debris managed to fall on Nord, enabling Shan, Revan, and their companions to kill Kang and escape Taris before the planet was completely devastated.

Nord survived, and escaped Taris as well. He met with Darth Malak and informed them of Shan's [[Rescue of Bastila Shan|escape]] through Carth Onasi's efforts. He also told Malak, along with the Sith Admiral [[Saul Karath]], that Revan, who was Malak's former [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], was still alive and operating as a Republic soldier. He took a contract from the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], with Malak asking him to capture Shan alive, but to kill her other companions. Nord tracked down and confronted Revan, who had been retrained in the Jedi ways and tasked to find the Star Forge&mdash;the ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that was churning out the ships for the Sith's fleet. Revan and his companions killed the bounty hunter.

{{ExcerptIU|
''What the Rancor lacked in intelligence it made up for in size, strength and ferocity. Conventional blasters were all but useless against its impenetrable hide, and I was forced to resort to more unorthodox methods to bring the beast down.''

''Some well placed mines near a watering hole were the first step, their explosions herding the creature into a dead-end canyon where I lay in wait, perched among the rocks.''

''As soon as the Rancor was below me, I dropped down onto its massive neck. It reared back, bucking and clawing in an effort to dislodge me, but I had the perfect position.''

''Unable to shake me, the monster opened its mouth in an outraged howl, and I was able to flip several frag grenades down its gaping maw.''

''The explosion blew me clear of the shredded corpse, but luckily the head was still intact. If I take it to Taris, I'm sure Davik will mount it in his trophy room along with the other heads I have collected for him.''

''Davik's also expressed interest in hiring me. I may take him up on his offer, even though I still have yet to claim the greatest hunting trophy of all: a pearl from one of the Krayt Dragons of Tatooine.''
|attrib=The last entry of Calo Nord's datapad, providing an account of a recent rancor hunt}}

==Behind the scenes==
Calo Nord's datapad was an item featured in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Xbox|Xbox]] and [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. It is also the only datapad that can be sold for credits, as all other data pads were worth zero credits.
